name: RunPod LoRA Trainer
description: Trains character/environment/prop LoRAs on a remote RunPod GPU endpoint instead of the local machine. An alternative to the local lora_trainer plugin — enabling this one disables lora_trainer. Requires a configured RunPod endpoint + API key (GUAARDVARK_RUNPOD_* env vars) and a deployed pod image from plugins/runpod_lora_trainer/pod/.
author: Guaardvark
